profiles.research: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, WebFetch, WebSearch
profiles.edit: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write

locate.what: find files, list call sites, count matches, map what a change touches

mechanical.what: edits and commands the brief spells out exactly: renames, version bumps, find and replace, a recipe applied per file

research.what: read docs, APIs, changelogs and web pages, return cited rows

implement.what: a specified code change in the files it owns, tests included when the goal asks

document.what: README, docs pages, changelog entries, comments and release notes, checked against the code

review.what: read a diff or a set of files and report findings with file:line evidence

verify.what: reproduce a claim or run the check with its own command, report confirmed or refuted with output

design.what: plan a change, weigh tradeoffs, split work into lanes with disjoint files

debug.what: reproduce a failure, find the root cause, name the fix and the files it touches

solve.what: one long, tangled unit end to end: work out the approach, make the change in the files it owns and prove it, where splitting would lose the thread
